Government Considers Increasing Lok Sabha Seats for Women's Quota

The central government is reportedly considering a significant increase in the number of Lok Sabha seats to accommodate the recently enacted women's reservation law. This move aims to implement the quota, which mandates reserving one-third of seats for women in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies. The specifics of the seat increase and the timeline for implementation are under discussion.
